notes.title: Steam Next Fest QA version Update
notes.content: [p][b]Update Notes – June 11, 2025[/b][/p][p]The June 11 version was created for internal QA purposes.[/p][p]The boss currently extends up to Stage 2, featuring the Yeti. Please note that the Yeti's design has not been finalized yet. We appreciate your understanding regarding this matter.[/p][p][b]Update Details:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tutorial enhancement[/p][/*][*][p]Yeti added[/p][/*][*][p]Spider difficulty reduced[/p][/*][/list][p]We welcome and appreciate all feedback![/p]
